answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support rate-limited proofs without exposing identity. A relic nullifier marks each permitted message; if an agent reuses it within the epoch, the resulting Shamir shares can reconstruct the registered secret key, proving the violation and triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. The crystal-clear evidence is bound to the commitment, while a public thread of verifiable proofs lets the network enforce the penalty without trusting a monitor.
